name: doc
description: Interpret OCR'd documents (invoices/forms) into structured fields, or propose an extraction template. The document text usually comes from the chat's attached OCR context.

tools.name: interpret_document
tools.description: Parse OCR'd document text into structured JSON: kvs (header key-values), items (detail tables), totals (sums), notes (remarks/explanations). Call when the user asks to 解读/整理/提取 a parsed document. Language- and layout-agnostic. If the user wants the result written to a sheet, call land_interpret_to_sheet instead (do not re-emit the rows yourself).

ocrText.description: OCR 识别出的文档全文（来自对话中的文档上下文）

tools.name: propose_recipe
tools.description: Generate an extraction-template candidate from OCR'd document text (fields: name/type/source/group + notes). Annotation labels (any language) are preferred as field names. Call when the user asks to 生成模板/建模板 for a document.

ocrText.description: OCR 识别出的文档全文

tools.name: land_interpret_to_sheet
tools.description: Interpret an OCR'd document AND write the structured result (kvs/items/totals/notes) to a new Excel sheet in one step — the rows never pass through the model. Call when the user asks to 整理成工作簿表格/写入工作簿/进工作簿 for a parsed document. Pass ocrText from the document context; do NOT reconstruct the rows yourself. If the user wants a custom column layout (e.g. 按 日期/类型/箱号/承运商 拆分), pass transform: {columns:[{name, mode: column|regex|constant|date, source?, pattern?, group?, value?}], dates?: [{from,to,date}]} — the tool applies it. Omit transform for the raw structured result.

ocrText.description: OCR 识别出的文档全文（来自对话中的文档上下文）

sheetName.description: 新工作表名（可空，默认 文档-解读）

transform.description: 可选列变换：columns 定义输出列（mode=column 取源列 / regex 提取 / constant 常量 / date 用 dates 行区间），dates 按 items 行序给行区间标日期

from.description: 起始行号（0-based，items 全局行序，含）
